title: Retry budget requires success replenishment AND metric emission
description: The RetryBudget.record_outcome method must replenish remaining on success AND emit a metric via orgops.metrics.emit for operational monitoring.
code:
# Retry Budget — Two Requirements

## 1. Replenish on Success
```python
if success:
    self.remaining = min(self.remaining + 1, self.max_budget)
```

## 2. Metric Emission (REQUIRED)
```python
import orgops.metrics
orgops.metrics.emit("retry.budget.consumed", self.remaining)
```
